title: Houthis and Saudis Trade Claims of Military Attacks as Conflict Escalates
summary_full: The Iran-backed militia in Yemen said it had downed a Saudi jet, while the Saudi-led military coalition accused it of firing a drone near Mecca. The Houthis denied doing so.
